rusted_blade.name: RUSTED BLADE
rusted_blade.description: A chipped village sword. It has seen better days, but it still bites.

ashfang_saber.name: ASHFANG SABER
ashfang_saber.description: Quenched in ash and honed on the bones of the risen.

veilcleaver.name: VEILCLEAVER
veilcleaver.description: Its edge hums when the dead draw near. The veil shivers at each cut.

duskbound_greatsword.name: DUSKBOUND GREATSWORD
duskbound_greatsword.description: A fallen knight's oath made steel. Heavy, patient and unforgiving.

hollow_redeemer.name: HOLLOW REDEEMER
hollow_redeemer.description: Forged in the guardian's furnace. Each kill feeds its purple fire.
